tickets.title: Prepare spring tuition funding schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month spring tuition funding schedule for Mira and Adrian Quillwhistle showing how much of the Marzipan Meadow College charges can come from Elin's 529 at Velvet Acorn Custody, the Teacup Comet Bank tuition set-aside ($21,000), and the Paper Otter Treasury fund ($48,000) without changing retirement contributions.
tickets.evidence: Mira asked for a month-by-month schedule showing how much of the Marzipan Meadow charges can come from Elin’s 529, the Teacup Comet tuition set-aside, and the Paper Otter Treasury fund without changing retirement contributions; the agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule, dated December 19, 202

tickets.title: Obtain itemized student account packet
tickets.text: Obtain the official Marzipan Meadow College billing packet for Elin Quillwhistle, including the itemized student account PDF needed to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories; the portal screenshot only showed tuition, housing, meal plan, and health fee lines.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain the packet, dated December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn 529 balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the balance discrepancy for Elin Quillwhistle's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody: Mira's mobile screenshot showed $67,400 while the downloaded statement showed $72,270, creating uncertainty about the amount available for the next payment.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to reconcile the balance discrepancy, dated December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify 529 payment or reimbursement workflow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for paying Marzipan Meadow College from Elin's 529 at Velvet Acorn Custody, since the college portal rejected the bank verification for direct 529 payment and displayed an error after two attempts, before any funds are moved.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to identify the workflow, dated December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate education funding projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using his existing 529 balance of $38,900 at Velvet Acorn Custody, expected test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection, dated December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare off-campus housing cost projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection for Elin Quillwhistle's next academic year showing which off-campus apartment rent, food, and utility amounts could fit into the education funding plan versus Mira and Adrian's parent cash flow, after the dorm contract ends.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection, dated January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan cost-gap merit aid estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a cost-gap estimate for Rowan Quillwhistle's college list before the first school deposit decision so Mira and Adrian can compare merit aid offers consistently, using the scholarship response calendar from Rowan's counselor.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the estimate, dated February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare tax estimate and sale-sequencing review
tickets.text: Prepare a tax estimate and sale-sequencing review for using the Paper Otter Custody taxable education reserve, noting unrealized gains in the equity index fund and the separate $48,000 Treasury position earmarked for tuition before the reserve is used.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the tax estimate and sale-sequencing review, dated January 3, 2024.
